title: Backspin: Reverse Your Voice
shortDescription: Record a line, hear it backwards, copy it and reveal the result.
fullDescription:
Your voice, with a twist.

Say a short line, hear it backwards, then try copying that sound. Backspin flips your attempt forwards and scores its sound, rhythm and length.

Play a quick round, pick a daily challenge, try freestyle or pass one phone between friends in party mode. Loop or slow down the backwards clip while you practise. Save takes on your phone and share a four-part clip: original, backwards, your copy and flipped.

Your first 10 scored rounds are free with all packs, effects and party sizes available. Backspin Plus is one optional lifetime purchase for unlimited rounds. No subscription or ads. Saved takes remain playable and shareable.

No account is needed. Recording and audio processing happen on your phone; clips leave it only when you choose to share.
